text: Great RPG motivation concept, but task filtering and sorting feel too limited. I want weekly tasks that can be completed any day, while still being visible all week. If a Daily is set for Sunday, it stays grey until then; if I filter due tasks only, I miss it. I’d like an option to show grey and due tasks together, or filter “tasks still to complete this week”. More sorting options by due date, priority, frequency, tags, or completion status would also help a lot.
